collection.title: Mini Countryman 2010 to 2016 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Mini Countryman 2010 to 2016 model which requires a 19" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" for the passengers side. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this Countryman, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
